title: AI Storage Bin Tracker
description: Photograph a storage bin and AI vision logs and tags what's inside, so you can search for any item and find which bin it's in. Built with Expo and React Native.

title: In-browser video to GIF, MP4, WebP editor
description: Turn any video into a looping GIF, MP4, WebM, WebP or APNG without uploading it. Trim on a timeline, set the speed, and pick a look like Grain, Noir or VHS. Conversion runs entirely in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm.

title: Table Read
description: Write or paste a story, then read it aloud while a Whisper speech model running on your own device follows along word by word. Nothing is uploaded, and optional sound-effect cues send ElevenLabs only short text prompts, never your audio.

title: Maydove
description: A map-first AI workspace for planning and generating ad creatives and social content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Place an idea on a shared map, attach audience, proof and tone, and an AI agent drafts outputs that stay linked to it, with a visual editor for graphics and carousels.

title: Krayla
description: Website for a mindfulness and yoga studio in Syracuse, NY. Visitors browse classes by intensity, meet the lead instructor, check a day-by-day schedule of classes and events, and book through Google Calendar appointments.
